look: Chalk geometry: a dark maths-explainer look (3Blue1Brown-style): clean vector dots, arrows and grids drawn in glowing strokes on a dark ground, shapes morphing smoothly, short serif captions. Same look as the Poisson, Metrics, IER, MeshAnything and Point2Mesh Part 1 films of this series.

scenes.name: Which way the arrows point
scenes.desc: A flipped dot arrow fights the oriented normal term; the unoriented term only asks for the same line.

scenes.name: Our four runs
scenes.desc: Four runs on the VGGSfM scan in one table, and what they teach.

scenes.name: Stray dots
scenes.desc: A shrink-wrap must cover every dot, so floaters in the MVS cloud pull out membranes.

scenes.name: The red patches
scenes.desc: Red shows the inside of the skin where it folded over; it is still closed.

scenes.name: Against the others
scenes.desc: Point2Mesh beside Poisson, IER and MeshAnything on the same scan.

scenes.name: Limits and strengths
scenes.desc: What Point2Mesh cannot do, beside what it always gets right.
